blurb: Golden Eagle Boat Charters offers private boat cruises around Stanley Park, Burrard Inlet, English Bay, and False Creek. They cater to private groups for events like birthday parties, corporate events, memorials, and fishing charters. Their vessels are Transport Canada inspected and piloted by ticketed captains familiar with local waters.
